whatHappening: TCS shares are in focus as today is the last day to buy for the Rs 12 dividend eligibility

summary: Indian markets are expected to open higher today following positive cues from GIFT Nifty, despite a significant selloff in the previous session. Key focus remains on TCS for its dividend deadline and the opening of the HD Fire Protect IPO. Global factors, including falling crude oil prices and rising geopolitical risks, continue to drive market volatility.
